t: You're looking at a statue of Charles Portal, Viscount Portal of Hungerford, standing in Victoria Embankment Gardens, outside the Ministry of Defence. Portal was a Marshal of the Royal Air Force. In the First World War he flew light bombers on the Western Front, rising to flight commander and then squadron commander. The sculptor was Oscar Nemon, born in Osijek, Croatia, who settled in England and is best known for his many statues of Winston Churchill.
